headline: Hydration and proton-transfer geometry tracked across respiratory and visual enzymes
label: Hydration And Proton Transport
summary: Three 2026 preprints tie local hydration and proton-transfer geometry to disease-relevant enzyme dysfunction in LHON and LCA.
synthesis: The three preprints treat proton-coupled energetics as the controlling variable, with hydration and proton-transfer geometry central to each analysis. An AlphaFold and VQE hybrid pipeline for RPE65 proposes an RQAS score relating proton-tunneling geometry to LCA clinical severity. Two complex I studies apply atomistic and multiscale reactive molecular dynamics. One reports that the ND6 m.14484T>C LHON mutation disrupts quinone binding and hydration networks. The other introduces a water wire connectivity metric to track proton transport along the lateral pathway and links that transport to hydration. What is new is the explicit linkage of local hydration and tunneling geometry to disease-relevant severity or dysfunction across distinct respiratory and visual enzyme systems. The common thread is computational, and the items present these disease links as simulation-based proposals.
